travelers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make one new production PNG sprite atlas for an original mobile fantasy game: EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows containing SIXTEEN different living traveling cities, with true transparent alpha everywhere outside each city. Equal cells, no labels or grid lines. Original warm hand-drawn Japanese animated fantasy storybook art: soft brown ink contours, translucent watercolor and gouache washes, warm cream plaster, muted terracotta and copper, weathered sea-green roofs, mossy plants, gentle sunlit ochres, charming asymmetry and hand-built mechanical details. Clear rounded silhouettes, visible brush softness, friendly and full of life. Do not imitate a specific existing character, creature, castle or film scene. No glossy 3D rendering, no hard plastic toy look, no dark gritty realism, no pixel art.

VERY IMPORTANT COMMON GEOMETRY FOR ALL SIXTEEN CITIES: consistent near-isometric three-quarter view from above and in front. Every city is an OPEN-FRONT U-SHAPED OR CRESCENT body, a rear cluster of buildings with two short wings curling forward at the left and right. The large central mouth is EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE, never a courtyard, never solid flooring, never a dark painted hole. Within every equal cell, the mouth center is at x=0.51, y=0.80; keep a large ellipse with horizontal radius 0.24 and vertical radius 0.145 completely transparent, and leave the middle of the front edge open to it. Buildings and legs must stay behind or to the sides of that space. This hole is for a runtime black portal drawn underneath the sprite. DO NOT put rocks, grass, walkways, stairs, water, a bridge, painted shadow, face, wheels or beams across the empty central mouth.

Give each traveling city an original little personality: paired warm lit window-eyes on its REAR main building, crooked steam chimneys, patchwork roofs, potted plants, trailing vines, little bells and hanging charms, tiny stubby walking legs or small floating fin-wings ONLY along its outer sides. All cities face the same direction. The rear main house can have a friendly expressive silhouette, but no person or creature fills the mouth. Maintain clear big color areas that read on a phone. Leave visible alpha gutters between every cell; keep steam wisps tiny and inside the cell, with no smoke crossing a grid line. Keep all roofs, feet, sails and hanging ornaments fully inside their own cell. No background scene, no paper rectangle behind a sprite, no floor tile, no shadows outside the city. No text, no writing, no logos.

EXACT ORDER, left to right:
ROW 1, cells 0–3, FOUR GROWTH STAGES of the same cozy traveler:
0 baby traveling inn: one little cream cottage with a crooked terracotta roof and warm window-eyes, short crescent wooden-stone side wings, a little chimney, two tiny side feet, the central open mouth still large and transparent.
1 young double-storey town: a stacked cozy inn, one extra small side house, patched teal roof, a copper kettle chimney and a little hanging lantern, same transparent open U mouth.
2 medium multi-tower village: three irregular towers and cottage rooftops, mossy balconies, vines, a small wind vane and side fin-wings, same transparent open U mouth.
3 mature grand traveling city: richer asymmetrical cluster of warm homes and towers, copper pipes, potted trees, several friendly windows and short outer walking legs, same open transparent mouth.

ROW 2, cells 4–7, FOUR WEAPON PERSONALITIES:
4 cannon mechanical town: warm terracotta inn with TWO clearly visible brass-and-iron cannons mounted on the LEFT and RIGHT front-side wings pointing outward, copper gears and steam pipes, same empty mouth.
5 frost garden town: delicate pale cyan crystal greenhouse roofs, snowy herbs and blue flowers, cozy warm windows, soft moss and pale stone side wings, same empty mouth.
6 sail and windmill town: patched sea-green canvas sails and an old wooden windmill growing out of cream cottages, lightweight outer fin-wings, same empty mouth.
7 lightning antenna town: copper aerials, glass cyan electrical globes and brass coils above a warm teal-roof inn, same empty mouth.

ROW 3, cells 8–11:
8 phoenix furnace town: a warm orange hearth core in the REAR building, little phoenix-shaped weather vane, copper chimney and russet roofs; same empty mouth.
9 cannon-and-wind sky fortress: two clear side cannons, patched sails, small mechanical fin-wings, warm sunlit copper and teal, same empty mouth.
10 cannon-and-frost glacier fortress: two clear side cannons among ice-crystal greenhouse rooftops and cream stone, cozy amber windows, same empty mouth.
11 frost-and-wind cloud garden: curved pale teal sails, blue flowers and small crystalline garden turrets, soft white accents, same empty mouth.

ROW 4, cells 12–15, FOUR HEROIC EVOLVED PERSONALITIES:
12 thunderheart cannon citadel: two large readable side cannons, a beautiful cyan copper-coil heart tower at the rear, little lightning aerials, energetic but friendly, same empty mouth.
13 sunforge sail city: golden and terracotta furnace cottages with saffron sails, a phoenix weather vane and trailing plants, same empty mouth.
14 singularity star-night traveler: a dreamy deep-indigo and muted teal town with golden lit window-eyes, an astrolabe, tiny star lanterns and a crescent weather vane, same empty mouth.
15 overclock clockwork traveler: asymmetrical copper clocks, warm cream houses, winding keys, a little pendulum and teal/coral patchwork roofs, same empty mouth.

The central alpha mouth cutout is mandatory in EVERY cell. Original artwork, warm watercolor animation feeling, complete clean isolated sprites with real transparency, no black or white background and no checkerboard pattern.

terrain.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. The supplied terrain image is the EDIT TARGET. Repaint it as one seamless repeating, top-down, very low-contrast pale meadow watercolor texture for a mobile action game. Preserve its role as an unobtrusive flat ground layer with no gameplay objects. Use warm hand-painted watercolor and gouache on subtly textured paper-like paint, soft pale sage and yellow-green washes, tiny delicate brush flecks of grass and faint warm ivory specks. Colors should stay close to muted light sage and warm pale grassy green, with gentle variation only.

No trees, no bushes, no rocks, no houses, no distinct flowers, no paths, no water, no fences, no shadows, no creatures, no objects, no text, no borders, no vignette, no perspective horizon. Replace the current hard triangular grass marks with very subtle short hand-painted grass strokes that blend into the surface. Make all four edges visually match so the square can tile. No pronounced central feature or large dark patches. Opaque full-bleed texture, no transparency. The result should harmonize with an original warm watercolor Japanese animated fantasy storybook world, while leaving enemies and projectiles easy to see.

effects.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a transparent 4x4 game VFX atlas. Image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE for this game's warm watercolor animation world. Repaint the effects with soft ink-edged animation brushwork, layered watercolor/gouache color, airy painted smoke and hand-drawn motion shapes. They must match the organic illustrated world of Image 2, not glossy CGI or hard vector starbursts.

Preserve EXACTLY four equal rows by four equal columns, same fixed effect center in every cell. Each row is four successive animation frames of ONE effect, from a concentrated initial impact through expansion to a dispersed finish. Keep generous transparent gutters. All smoke, shards, sparks, leaves, glows and paint strokes stay inside their own cell. True alpha outside the effects, no rectangle, no background texture, no labels, no text.
Row 1: warm amber/orange cannon impact, first bright little strike, second larger painted fire/smoke bloom, third loose ochre smoke and amber fragments, fourth fading soft warm smoke ring.
Row 2: cyan/ice-blue frost shatter, first crisp pale icy impact, second spreading blue crystal burst, third separated gentle ice shards and frost puffs, fourth faint drifting fragments.
Row 3: sea-green/ivory wind vortex, four successive sweeping curved hand-painted wind ribbons and a few leaves; open centers and airy edges.
Row 4: muted violet-and-gold magical absorption, four clockwise inward-swirling ink-and-watercolor ribbon stages ending in one little warm star glint.
Bright readable cores, softer secondary edges. Do not include fire that looks like blood, realistic smoke simulations, objects or characters. Keep colors useful for play: orange impact, cyan frost, green wind, violet/gold absorption.
